subject.title: Feature: Add per-model generation timeout config

question: Should OpenClaw add a new agent-level global/per-model total-generation timeout, or keep timeout configuration limited to provider HTTP and whole-run budgets?
rationale: The request adds compatibility-sensitive public config plus timeout precedence and fallback semantics that source inspection cannot choose safely without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add Generation Budget
options.body: Add a typed non-resetting total-generation budget at agent defaults and per-model entries with documented precedence and fallback classification.

options.title: Keep Existing Budgets
options.body: Decline the new surface and document provider request timeout plus whole-run timeout as the supported controls.

recommendation.title: Add Generation Budget
recommendation.body: Add a typed non-resetting total-generation budget at agent defaults and per-model entries with documented precedence and fallback classification.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest history and discussion owner for the current model-config surface and the proposed contract.
